exposure: Mode of vaginal delivery (spontaneous vs. instrumental)
outcome: Length of Stay (LoS) after vaginal deliveries
Percentage of LoS longer than early discharge benchmarks
cohort: The study included mothers and term newborns who had vaginal deliveries in the Friuli Venezia Giulia region of Italy between 2005 and 2015.
finding: Maternity centers and their specific practice patterns were identified as the primary determinants of Length of Stay after vaginal deliveries, proving more influential than individual maternal health or newborn clinical factors.
mod_finding: The adjusted mean Length of Stay was found to be higher following instrumental vaginal deliveries compared to spontaneous vaginal deliveries.
